description: Start connecting one connector from list_connectors, by its name. Call it only when the user asked to connect that service. One that needs no sign-in is added on the spot and its tools are ready. One that needs a sign-in comes back with `sign_in_url`: give the user that link to finish in their browser, and do not say it is connected until they have. Already added: it returns the connector's page instead.

name.description: The connector's name as list_connectors reported it, e.g. 'Notion'.

name: add_connector
title: Add a connector
